actions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: For 1 minute, the hobgoblin can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the hobgoblin. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the hobgoblin has the Incapacitated condition.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Wonder
damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any Divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: Detect Magic, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation. 3/day each: Dispel Magic, Identify, Lesser Restoration, Tongues. 1/day each: Greater Restoration, Legend Lore.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Attack
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx makes one Claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack: +4, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) Slashing damage, or 7 (2d6) Slashing damage if the swarm has half its Hit Points or fewer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boss makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Rallying Cry
bonusActions.description: The boss chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target gains 5 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the limb takes Fire or Acid damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The vampire familiar regains 2 Hit Points at the start of its turn. The vampire familiar dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vampire familiar can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. The vampire familiar regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
